text:
alex: Heads up — noticed a p99 latency regression on private/vpc small-GPU clusters after the kernel-selection change in PR #4572. p50 stable, p95 +5%, p99 +18% over the last 6h.

mira: Ack. Which workload/profile?

alex: Most visible on chat-heavy traces with short sequences (avg seq=80 tokens), token-level batching. Metric: private-us-east-2-smallgpu cluster. Example: gen_requests/s: 600 -> 620 (ok), but p99 latency 210ms -> 250ms.

sam: Can you paste the profiler output?

alex: Pasted below — sampled stacks from the serving runtime:

```
flamegraph sample (top 6):
serve_loop::handle_batch
-> continuous_batcher::form_batch
-> runtime_queue::dequeue_token_budget
-> kv_cache::maybe_evict
-> cudaMemcpyAsync
-> cudaLaunchKernel (matmul_small)
```

Most time shifted to memcpy + small-kernel launch overhead. Looks like kernel-selection now prefers a quantized small-kernel that has worse launch + memcpy overhead for small batches.

jen: That matches my local run. For small batches (<512 tokens) the new kernel has higher wall-clock due to more host-device roundtrips. Also saw KV cache churn — eviction path kicking in more often, probably due to batch composition change.

paul: Could be token-budget packing too aggressive. If we overpack multiple short sequences into a single batch, we end up with many small internal sub-batches and extra memcpy ops. What's current batching config on private?

alex: Current override for private smallgpu (from /etc/redwood/serve/private-conf.yaml):

```
continuous_batcher:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  max_batch_elems: 32
  min_fill_ms: 4
  token_budget_per_tenant:
    default: 1024
    vpc_smallgpu_override: 512
  prefer_small_batches: true
  queue_priorities:
    - latency_sensitive
    - default
    - bulk
```

sam: A few quick hypotheses:
- prefer_small_batches=true + min_fill_ms=4 -> creates many tiny batches with new kernel launch penalty
- token_budget 512 still allows aggressive packing across short sequences causing KV interleaving and eviction
- kernel-selection heuristics may prefer kernel A for quantized config but kernel A has high per-launch overhead on T4-like small GPUs

mira: Agreed. Quick mitigation options: 1) increase min_fill_ms to 8–12 for private smallgpu, 2) lower prefer_small_batches to false for private, 3) lower token_budget_per_tenant to 256 or add tenant-specific override for chat workloads.

alex: I ran an A/B locally: set min_fill_ms=10 and set prefer_small_batches=false -> p99 dropped ~12% in a synthetic short-seq workload. But tail still above baseline on real traffic.

jen: We should also verify KV cache eviction thresholds. If eviction is happening during batch formation we pay memcpy/serialisation overhead per request. Suggest enabling KV debug sampling for one private cluster: add kv_cache.trace=true for 0.1% of requests.

paul: Also request we run kernel microbench on the suspect kernels: kernel_small_quant vs kernel_small_fused with tools/nvprof-wrapper.sh. Sequence: run /scripts/kernel-bench --model gpt-small --seq 64 --batch 8/16/32 to measure launch+memcpy.

alex: I ran kernel-bench quick:

```
seq=64 batch=8 -> kernel_small_quant: 1.8ms launch+exec, memcpy 0.9ms
seq=64 batch=32 -> kernel_small_quant: 2.2ms, memcpy 3.1ms
seq=64 batch=32 -> kernel_small_fused: 1.2ms, memcpy 1.0ms
```

Conclusion: fused kernel has better amortized cost for medium batches; quant kernel acceptable only when memcpy dominated by big contiguous blocks. Our continuous batching is producing many fragmented memcpy calls.

sam: Actionable plan:
- Toggle pref_small_batches=false for private clusters and roll to canary (alex will do).
- Increase min_fill_ms to 10 on private to allow better amortization (mira will change config).
- Add token_budget override 256 for chat-heavy tenants in private (paul will author PR).
- Enable kv_cache.trace=0.1% and collect eviction counts over 12h (jen).
- Run kernel microbench across affected instance types and add a kernel-selection rule: prefer fused kernel when avg_batch_tokens >= 768 (sam).

alex: I'll roll the prefer_small_batches toggle to 5% canary now. deploy-bot: starting deployment to private-us-east-2-smallgpu canary.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: canary/private-us-east-2-smallgpu -> rolling (5%). See CI: https://ci.redwood/4572.

mira: I put a draft config PR for min_fill_ms and token_budget overrides: #4598. Please review.

jen: For investigation, I exported flamegraphs and a tiny replayer snapshot for 1k requests to /tmp/contbatch-investigation-{date}.tar.gz. Uploading to the perf bucket now.

paul: I'll prepare kernel microbench job and schedule it on smallgpu pool (non-production) for tomorrow morning.

alex: Nice. If canary looks good we'll roll fully; otherwise we'll revert kernel selection change in PR #4572. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: One more note: add a metric for memcpy_count and kernel_launch_count to runtime telemetry so we can track this automatically. Filing ticket INF-1287.

mira: Added INF-1287 with suggested dashboards and alert thresholds.

alex: Closing loop — will post results in ~12h.
